page_title: HOF 1-2 MAI | Hoffenheim v Mainz 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lennard Maloney (Mainz) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+4' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and it's Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Paul Nebel will be replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
87' Christian Ilzer has decided to make a change. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) replaces Tim Lemperle.
84' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
84' Substitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) has come on for Alexander Prass.
83' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
80' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
79' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card.
79' 1 - 2 Goal! Phillip Tietz (Mainz) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.

79' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a stunning save!
79' Paul Nebel (Mainz) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
75' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Jae-Sung Lee is replaced by Sota Kawasaki (Mainz).
75' Substitution. Sheraldo Becker will be replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
74' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
73' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) commits a foul and Harm Osmers immediately signals a free kick.
72' Hoffenheim hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

67' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Phillip Tietz (Mainz) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann pulls off a comfortable save.
66' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

62' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) slammed the ball from a mid-range free kick towards the net! He unleashed a low shot that went to the left, exactly where the keeper was standing. Such an easy save for him.
61' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) replacing Fisnik Asllani.
61' That will be all from Vladimir Coufal who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim).
60' The foul by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) was seen by Harm Osmers who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' A short pass finds Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
53' The resulting corner from Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) comes to nothing.
50' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
49' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Harm Osmers saw the whole situation.
47' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
46' The game is interrupted now, Danny da Costa (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silvan Widmer leaves the pitch and Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) launches a cross from the corner, but Daniel Batz is alert to thwart the effort.
45+2' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The referee is firm and issues Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) a deserved yellow card.
41' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is flagged for offside.
38' A pass from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Daniel Batz and the move breaks down.
37' The substitution has been made. Kacper Potulski (Mainz) has replaced Dominik Kohr.
36' Paul Nebel (Mainz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
33' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
32' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It's a throw-in for Hoffenheim.
31' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
30' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

30' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim), who directs his shot to the bottom left corner, but the keeper is there to block the effort.

26' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann pulls off a great save to deny him.
23' 1 - 1 Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) waited for a rebound on the edge of the box and left the goalkeeper stranded with his beautiful attempt which went in off the crossbar.
19' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
17' The players claim that Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
13' 0 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Mainz) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
12' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
11' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the right post, but Daniel Batz is alert and denies him.

10' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
10' The referee awards a corner and Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) goes over to take it.
9' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) works the corner short.

9' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
7' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
4' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) is caught offside!
3' Referee Harm Osmers sees the trip by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Harm Osmers.
